method: Manual read-only browser inspection of public pages and displayed controls

observed: Homepage offers USA and Europe destination tabs.
USA links include BLADE Airport, Westchester, Hamptons, Westchester to JFK/EWR, and BLADE Anywhere private charter.
Sign In and Sign Up navigation links are visible.
Apple App Store and Google Play links support app handoff.
Cookie prompt offers Accept, Decline and Preferences; inspection chose Decline.
A promotional email signup popup appeared and was dismissed without entering information.
Airport service is described between Manhattan and JFK or Newark.
Flight search controls include From, To, Date, Desired curbside arrival, Passengers and Find a flight.
Displayed defaults included Manhattan, JFK Airport and one passenger.
Page advertised fares from $195 per seat at inspection time; this is not a fare inventory or measured booking value.
A notice said Manhattan-JFK service was limited September 21-22 due to a temporary flight restriction during the UN assembly.
FAQs cover baggage, changes, cancellation, timing and lounges.
BLADE Anywhere describes chartering helicopters, jets and turboprops.
BLADE Anywhere buttons link to /flight_search.
The cost-estimator link points to https://blade.flyblade.com/booking_inquiries/new.
Following that estimator link resolved to https://www.blade.com//booking_inquiries/new in this inspection.
Private Jet Charter Cost Estimator form displays Origin, Destination, Departure Date and Your Email fields.
The form has a GET ESTIMATE button.
Page text says aircraft and price choices appear on a next page; that next page was not visited.
Signup form displays first name, last name, email, phone, password and optional referral code fields.
Phone is described as contact information regarding flights.
The page contains a Sign Up button and a Sign In link.
Search Flights displays Origin, Destination, Swap direction, Passengers and a disabled Next button before route entry.
Key Routes include NYC to Hamptons, South Florida, Aspen and Nantucket/Cape; Los Angeles to Aspen is also offered.
Route buttons link to /flight_search with origin and destination query parameters. No search was submitted.

notObserved: No search, quote, signup, payment or reservation form was submitted.
No real visitor records, conversions, ad performance, cookies or user identifiers were collected.
Actual dataLayer event names, GTM firing behavior and network delivery success were not measured.
Flight results, checkout, payment, confirmation and app installation were not inspected.
A cross-domain booking boundary was not established; the estimator link resolved to the main site.
modelingAssumptions: Session volumes, journey mix, channel shares, device mix, consent probabilities and dropoff rates are invented test parameters.
Event names, ad campaigns, conversion actions, identifiers, prices, lead values, timestamps and attribution are synthetic contracts.
Completed purchases and submitted inquiries/signup events are inferred modeled outcomes, not observed website completions.
Cross-domain attribution loss, server forwarding, deduplication, reporting delay and platform outage are stress models, not findings about BLADE.
Service-availability and business-demand changes are non-tracking-fault controls.
